title: Rory and the Starlit Glade
verses:
When the sun drifted down past the hills in the west,
And the valley was filled with a shimmering shade,
Gentle Rory called out that it was time for a rest,
And he led all his friends to a cozy night glade.

High above them flew Nia, who watched from the sky,
While Psittaco nestled down deep in her wing.
As the moon rose so high and the breezes blew by,
The tiny guide whispered a song he would sing.

Quick Ricky was prancing with energy still,
But Tilly found leaves that were cozy and deep.
She slowed his fast feet near the foot of the hill,
And helped him prepare for a wonderful sleep.

Huge Benny sank down like a mountain of gray,
His heavy feet resting upon the soft moss.
He sighed as the last of the light faded away,
While starlight danced gently and silver across.

The blossoms of blue started closing their heads,
As twilight came down on the moss-covered ground.
The friends curled up close in their softest of beds,
Without a single huff or a whisper of sound.

Then Rory yawned wide as he tucked in his tail,
And watched as the stars gave a soft, cozy light.
A slumbery breeze drifted over the vale,
To wish all the dinosaurs peace and goodnight.
